package vparquet4

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/backend"
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestPulseDefaultStatus(t *testing.T) {
	b, e := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv("PULSE_FIXTURE_ROOT") + "/test/fixtures/otlp/protoc-trace-values.protobuf")
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	var input tempopb.Trace
	if e = proto.Unmarshal(b, &input); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	span := input.ResourceSpans[0].ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0]
	if span.Status != nil {
		t.Fatal("fixture status unexpectedly present")
	}
	row, _ := traceToParquet(&backend.BlockMeta{}, span.TraceId, &input, nil)
	out := ParquetTraceToTempopbTrace(&backend.BlockMeta{}, row)
	got := out.ResourceSpans[0].ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0]
	if got.Status == nil || got.Status.Code != 0 {
		t.Fatal("stored trace did not materialize unset status")
	}
	report := map[string]any{"input_status_present": false, "stored_output_status_present": true, "stored_output_status_code": got.Status.Code, "stored_scope_present": out.ResourceSpans[0].ScopeSpans[0].Scope != nil, "stored_resource_present": out.ResourceSpans[0].Resource != nil}
	raw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(report, "", "  ")
	if e = os.WriteFile("/tmp/pulse-grafana-client/default-status-oracle.json", raw, 0644); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
}
